name: elevenlabs
summary: Completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Installed the Python SDK (elevenlabs + python-dotenv), created the example script using the provided code, and successfully generated an MP3 audio file from text via the ElevenLabs API. The output file /home/daytona/output.mp3 is 46,019 bytes with a valid MP3 header (ID3 tag), confirming the text-to-speech generation worked.
deviations: The quickstart's example uses `play(audio)` to stream audio through speakers. Since the sandbox is headless with no audio output, I replaced the `play()` call with code that writes the audio stream to a file and verifies the MP3 header. This is the only deviation — all other steps (SDK install, API key usage, voice ID, model ID, output format) followed the quickstart exactly.
